chapters.title: Two births announced
chapters.summary: Luke writes an orderly account. The angel Gabriel announces John's birth to Zechariah and Jesus' birth to Mary, who answers, be it unto me according to thy word. Mary sings her Magnificat.

chapters.title: The birth of Jesus
chapters.summary: Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger. Angels announce good tidings of great joy to shepherds. Simeon and Anna greet Him in the temple, and at twelve He stays in His Father's house.

chapters.title: John prepares the way
chapters.summary: John the Baptist preaches repentance and baptizes Jesus. The Spirit descends and God calls Him His beloved Son. Jesus' family line goes back to Adam.

chapters.title: Good news to the poor
chapters.summary: Jesus is tempted in the wilderness. In Nazareth's synagogue He reads Isaiah: the Spirit of the Lord is upon me to preach good news to the poor. His hometown rejects Him.

chapters.title: Fishers of men
chapters.summary: After a miraculous catch, Simon falls at Jesus' knees and is called. Jesus heals a leper and a paralyzed man, and calls Levi: I came to call sinners to repentance.

chapters.title: Love your enemies
chapters.summary: Jesus chooses twelve apostles and teaches on the plain: blessed are the poor; love your enemies; be merciful as your Father is merciful.

chapters.title: Forgiven much
chapters.summary: Jesus heals a centurion's servant, raises a widow's son, and lets a sinful woman anoint His feet. Her many sins are forgiven, for she loved much.

chapters.title: Seed and storm
chapters.summary: Women support Jesus' ministry. He tells the parable of the sower, calms a storm, frees a possessed man, heals a woman and raises Jairus' daughter.

chapters.title: Take up your cross
chapters.summary: Jesus sends out the twelve, feeds five thousand, is confessed as the Christ, and is transfigured. Whoever follows Him must take up their cross daily.

chapters.title: The good Samaritan
chapters.summary: Jesus sends out seventy-two. Asked who is my neighbor, He tells of a Samaritan who helps a beaten traveler. Mary sits at His feet while Martha is busy serving.

chapters.title: Teach us to pray
chapters.summary: Jesus teaches the disciples to pray and urges them to keep asking, seeking and knocking. He rebukes the religious leaders.

chapters.title: Do not worry
chapters.summary: Beware hypocrisy and greed, as the rich fool learned. Consider the ravens and lilies, and seek God's kingdom. Be ready like servants awaiting their master.

chapters.title: Repent and bear fruit
chapters.summary: Jesus calls all to repent, tells of a barren fig tree, heals a bent woman on the Sabbath, and weeps for Jerusalem.

chapters.title: The great banquet
chapters.summary: Jesus heals on the Sabbath, teaches humility at the table, and tells of a great banquet where the poor are invited. Count the cost of following Him.

chapters.title: The lost are found
chapters.summary: Three parables of joy: a lost sheep, a lost coin and a lost son whose father runs to embrace him. This my son was dead, and is alive again.

chapters.title: The rich man and Lazarus
chapters.summary: The parable of the shrewd manager: you cannot serve God and money. A rich man in torment and poor Lazarus at Abraham's side.

chapters.title: Ten lepers
chapters.summary: Jesus teaches on forgiveness and faith. Ten lepers are healed and only one, a Samaritan, returns to give thanks. The kingdom of God is within you.

chapters.title: Persistent prayer
chapters.summary: A persistent widow and a humble tax collector teach about prayer. Jesus blesses children, meets a rich ruler, and heals a blind man near Jericho.

chapters.title: Zacchaeus
chapters.summary: Zacchaeus the tax collector climbs a tree to see Jesus and is changed. The Son of Man came to seek and save the lost. Jesus enters Jerusalem and weeps over it.

chapters.title: Questions in the temple
chapters.summary: The leaders question Jesus' authority. He tells of wicked tenants, answers on taxes and resurrection, and warns about the scribes.

chapters.title: The widow's mites
chapters.summary: A poor widow gives two small coins, more than all the rest. Jesus foretells Jerusalem's fall and His coming: lift up your heads, for your redemption draws near.

chapters.title: The Last Supper
chapters.summary: Jesus shares the Passover: this is my body, given for you. He prays on the Mount of Olives, not my will but yours, is arrested, and Peter denies Him three times.

chapters.title: Father, forgive them
chapters.summary: Pilate and Herod find no fault, yet Jesus is crucified. He prays, "Father, forgive them," promises paradise to a criminal, and commits His spirit to God.

chapters.title: The road to Emmaus
chapters.summary: Women find the tomb empty. The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus and is known in the breaking of bread. He appears to the eleven and is taken up into heaven.
